name: Jack Rampage and the Disasters
source:
Jack Rampage and the Disasters is a short visual novel where you meet two demons and hang with them! If you make the right choices, you can become friends. Or maybe more like a hostage...?

[From [url=https://electricfrank3n.itch.io/jack-rampage-and-the-disasters]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Jack Rampage and the Disasters》是一部短篇视觉小说。你将遇见两个恶魔，与他们一起消磨时光！只要作出正确选择，就能成为朋友。又或许，你更像是他们的人质…？

[摘自[url=https://electricfrank3n.itch.io/jack-rampage-and-the-disasters]itch.io[/url]]
